answer: Every claim climbs the voyage of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the saffron re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the karst of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
